objective: Close the declaration-only half of root finding S5 by applying one minimal, separately accepted final capability mutation whose metrics commands, Python HTTP transport status, help, manifest, schema, tests, and explicit non-claims exactly match accepted evidence, then rerun the full terminal lifecycle on the new revision.

risk.rationale: The source edit is small, but it is the final public capability truth and invalidates prior source, review, release, Install, reversal, Dogfood, and KGI evidence; any overclaim defeats terminal closure.

disallowed_actions: Create a manifest or launch while any exact prerequisite remains UNBOUND
Modify product behavior, counters, routes, commands, storage, authority, or lifecycle state under the candidate
Claim a command or surface without exact accepted evidence
Delete an honest partial or not-claimed row
Reuse source review, build, Install, reversal, Dogfood, issue, or KGI evidence from the pre-mutation SHA
Apply another product mutation after the accepted capability delta without returning to Freeze/Plan

non_goals: Launch before all lifecycle prerequisites are exact
Convert partial coverage into a complete claim without evidence
Review devcontainer, CI, host, packaging, or agent wrappers

invariants.statement: Authoring begins only after every product, metrics, complexity/conformance, review-disposition, Close, Install, Dogfood, issue, and KGI prerequisite is bound to one clean pre-advertisement revision.
invariants.falsification_test: Leave one prerequisite UNBOUND, use a stale report, or change the pre-advertisement tree; status must remain blocked.

invariants.statement: The candidate changes only manager-bound capability/help/manifest/schema/conformance declarations and direct tests; it adds no behavior.
invariants.falsification_test: Add a product, counter, route, storage, authority, or unrelated path; exact review must reject the candidate.

invariants.statement: Every advertised command/surface has exact accepted evidence and every residual remains explicit partial or not-claimed across all public representations.
invariants.falsification_test: Add an unsupported claim, omit an accepted row, retain a stale value, or diverge help/JSON/schema/Rust/Python; conformance must fail.

invariants.statement: Applying the accepted capability delta creates a new terminal candidate requiring fresh Close, review, two-build Install, installed reversals, Dogfood, conformance, issue synchronization, and KGI/KPI finality.
invariants.falsification_test: Reference an old source/binary SHA or reuse any pre-mutation result; terminal validation must fail.

validation.command: Recompute every accepted product/report/composition/metrics/complexity identity and the pre-advertisement Close, Install, Dogfood, issue, and KGI evidence.
validation.purpose: Prevent advertising from stale or incomplete evidence.

validation.command: A fresh Fugu session returns READY or BLOCK with one claim-to-exact-evidence row and minimal changed-path set for every public capability byte.
validation.purpose: Shift overclaim and stale-value defects before authoring.

validation.command: Run direct capability tests, overclaim mutations, help/JSON/manifest/schema/Rust/Python conformance, source-doc checks, and exact output-scope validation.
Freeze parent/head/tree/patch/write-set/log digests and clean state; an independent Fugu session reviews the immutable declaration-only candidate.
validation.purpose: Separate authorship from final public acceptance.

validation.command: After manager application, rerun complete Close, independent High review, reproducible two-build Install, installed reversals, canonical and real-repository Dogfood, capability/conformance, issue synchronization, and committed-final KGI/KPI on the new SHA.
validation.purpose: Prevent transfer of stale terminal evidence across the last product mutation.
